summary.text: Kasie Whitener is a former chair of the Libertarian Party of South Carolina and the party's 2026 U.S. Senate nominee. She was born in Florence, South Carolina, holds a Ph.D., and has worked as an assistant professor.

paragraphs.text: Born in Florence, South Carolina, and graduated from Herndon High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Clemson University (1999), a graduate degree from Winthrop University (2004) and a Ph.D. from Capella University (2014).
Her career experience includes working as an assistant professor.
Served as chair of the Libertarian Party of South Carolina.
Defeated Jason Brenkus at the Libertarian Party convention on April 11, 2026 to become the party's U.S. Senate nominee.
